name: Out to the sandbank
led_by: A local guide from the beach club
when: At low tide. The beach club has the day's times
live: The sea draws back and a ribbon of white sand appears offshore. Walk out, sit a while in the quiet, and swim back as the tide returns.
good_to_know: Tide times change daily. Water shoes help on the walk out.
alt: Rippled white sand and shallow turquoise water at low tide
